summary: Second-year Software Engineering student at the State University of Maringá (UEM), Brazil, focused on Data Engineering, cloud and AI.
At RR Transportes e Terraplanagem, I built the management system (ERP) the company uses today to track its fleet trips, costs and payments.
At Main - Soluções em Software, I am a sales and projects intern: I prospect clients, negotiate contracts, gather requirements and follow deliveries.
At UEM, I do undergraduate research (PIBIC) on Item Response Theory and AI and co-organize Cloud Native Maringá, a community bringing cloud events to the university starting in 2027.

projects.name: Logistics ERP
projects.summary: A system I built and put into production at RR Transportes. The company had no real control over the money coming in and going out: trips, costs and freight for 9 trucks, about 85 trips a month, lived in spreadsheets, paper and WhatsApp. Now the manager follows everything on a dashboard and drivers submit data from their phones, even without signal. As a result, the finance team's payday review dropped from 8 to 3 hours, or 62.5% less time.
highlights: Shows each trip's and each truck's results in dashboards and charts, with receipt photos
Compares each freight against the ANTT legal minimum rate, using the table in force on the trip date
Sends notifications when a document is about to expire or maintenance is due
Protects data with hashed passwords (scrypt), login lockout, change auditing and tested daily backups
Automated tests (pytest and Playwright) and continuous integration on GitHub Actions
projects.architectureTitle: Production architecture, on a Linux VPS
projects.deployment: In production on a Linux VPS, with nginx, HTTPS (Let's Encrypt) and services isolated by systemd
